summary: The team is executing a global marketing strategy focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China for search/AI visibility, while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and resolving an Outlook lockout.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the global marketing strategy sync from June 30, where Asia Star and Intelligent China were set as the top two promotional priorities, with a target of top-five ranking for China executive program searches within seven months. Joseph is drafting search visibility areas and analyzing Asia Star participant profiles, while the team audits conversion tracking. The Knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team favored the current design with menu categorization changes and Joseph's editorial-style layout, and Joker is revising the design based on feedback. This week, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding accounts, updating passwords, and contacting JSB to confirm backend unlock. Upcoming items include finalizing the Knowledge redesign with a working session, and preparing for the homepage launch, after which Ira will send the updated PPT and email to Zongchao. Other upcoming tasks involve reviewing brand prompts, a YouTube edit plan, and confirming press release and report approvals.

decisions.text: Stale saved credentials across devices were the cause of the repeated account lockout.
Remove the standalone videos section; disperse videos by topic across the site
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu)
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage
Bring BCI (and BSI) index banners into the Knowledge section
Use the current Knowledge design as the base, taking select inspiration from Joseph's editorial layout
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two promotional priorities; US programs (Stanford, Columbia) deprioritized, Berkeley as possible third.
Target top-five ranking for China executive program searches within seven months.
